items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So Billy Shaw called me over. He'd lost a guy, and he wanted to hire me as an agent... So I said, 'Let's make a deal. I'll start to work for you the first of the year.'

ctx.x: You're talking about working with Shaw. How did you go with Shaw?
Well, how I got to Shaw, I used to... Shaw used to call me and give me the attraction he had open on
